description: GET /v1/merchants/me/balance - Live returns the sole monetary prepaid balance and spend; Test returns informational gas-cost estimates with billing=estimate_only and no balance fields. Test requires no funding and never creates monetary holds or debits. Amounts are USD microdollars (x 10^6) as decimal strings. Requires mode unless exactly one key mode is cached. Read-only.
name: paymaster_balance_get
title: Read Live balance or Test cost estimates
